posts.en:
dsh-layered-memory is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Layered memory pipeline for DSH: auto-distills conversations into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile (L0–L3), with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, chat/work family separation, and context injection before each model step.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b05b65bd7b0d3854ce3a.html
